packageRules.description: Auto-merge everything — major/minor/patch/pin/digest — once required CI is green (backend tests+build, frontend lint+build, full Docker build). CI is the gate, not semver.
Group all non-major npm updates into one weekly PR per workspace
better-sqlite3 majors track Node ABI — still auto-merges (the Docker build step compiles/installs the native addon, so a real ABI break fails CI), but flagged for a look since it's a native module
